import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULUS_VALUE = 998244353;
    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int n = readInt();
        int[] rockSciPaper1 = readNumbersList();
        int[] rockSciPaper2 = readNumbersList();

        int rock1 = rockSciPaper1[0], sci1 = rockSciPaper1[1], paper1 = rockSciPaper1[2];
        int rock2 = rockSciPaper2[0], sci2 = rockSciPaper2[1], paper2 = rockSciPaper2[2];

        System.out.println(findMinimum(rock1, sci1, paper1, rock2, sci2, paper2) + " " + getMaxScore(rock1, sci1, paper1, rock2, sci2, paper2));
    }

    static int getMaxScore(int rock1, int sci1, int paper1, int rock2, int sci2, int paper2) {
        return Math.min(rock1, sci2) + Math.min(sci1, paper2) + Math.min(paper1, rock2);
    }

    static int matchTypes(int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) {
            return 0;
        } else if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1)) {
            return 1;
        } else {
            return -1;
        }
    }

    static int computeMinScore(List<int[]> l1, List<int[]> l2) {
        int total = 0;
        int c1 = 0, c2 = 0;
        while (!l1.isEmpty() || !l2.isEmpty()) {
            if (c1 == 0 && !l1.isEmpty()) {
                c1 = l1.remove(l1.size() - 1)[0];
                int type1 = l1.isEmpty() ? 0 : l1.get(l1.size() - 1)[1];
            }
            if (c2 == 0 && !l2.isEmpty()) {
                c2 = l2.remove(l2.size() - 1)[0];
                int type2 = l2.isEmpty() ? 0 : l2.get(l2.size() - 1)[1];
            }
            int minCount = Math.min(c1, c2);
            int matchTypeScore = matchTypes(getType(c1, l1), getType(c2, l2));
            total += Math.max(0, minCount * matchTypeScore);
            if (c1 < c2) {
                c2 -= c1;
                c1 = 0;
            } else if (c1 > c2) {
                c1 -= c2;
                c2 = 0;
            } else {
                c1 = c2 = 0;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int getType(int count, List<int[]> list) {
        if (list.isEmpty()) return 0;
        return list.get(list.size() - 1)[1];
    }

    static int findMinimum(int rock1, int sci1, int paper1, int rock2, int sci2, int paper2) {
        List<List<int[]>> perms1 = generatePermutations(new int[][] {
            {rock1, 1},
            {sci1, 2},
            {paper1, 3}
        });
        List<List<int[]>> perms2 = generatePermutations(new int[][] {
            {rock2, 1},
            {sci2, 2},
            {paper2, 3}
        });
        int minAns = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (List<int[]> p1 : perms1) {
            for (List<int[]> p2 : perms2) {
                List<int[]> p1Copy = deepCopy(p1);
                List<int[]> p2Copy = deepCopy(p2);
                minAns = Math.min(minAns, computeMinScore(p1Copy, p2Copy));
            }
        }
        return minAns;
    }

    static List<List<int[]>> generatePermutations(int[][] array) {
        List<List<int[]>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(array, 0, result);
        return result;
    }

    static void permute(int[][] array, int start, List<List<int[]>> result) {
        if (start == array.length - 1) {
            List<int[]> permutation = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int[] item : array) {
                permutation.add(item.clone());
            }
            result.add(permutation);
        } else {
            for (int i = start; i < array.length; i++) {
                swap(array, start, i);
                permute(array, start + 1, result);
                swap(array, start, i);
            }
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[][] array, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
    }

    static List<int[]> deepCopy(List<int[]> list) {
        List<int[]> copy = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int[] arr : list) {
            copy.add(arr.clone());
        }
        return copy;
    }

    static int readInt() throws IOException {
        if (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        }
        return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
    }

    static int[] readNumbersList() throws IOException {
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int[] nums = new int[parts.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
            nums[i] = Integer.parseInt(parts[i]);
        }
        return nums;
    }
}
